title: Size.
officialText:
Fans shall have a maximum individual capacity of 30,000 cfm (14.2 m3/s). The aggregate capacity of smoke
exhaust fans shall be determined by the equation:
C=A × 300 (Equation 9-4)
where:
C = Capacity of mechanical ventilation required, in cubic feet per minute (m3/s).
A = Area of roof vents provided in square feet (m2) in accordance with Table 910.3.
